decisions.alternatives_note: NONE ENUMERATED DETERMINISTICALLY -- polymer_rules.json:classes.PEST has no forcefield_alternatives, and this layer will not invent one. The moiety probe names what actually types this SMILES; the literature critic may name a candidate on the evidence.

findings: Critic verdict 'agrees' on D-01_ff accepted; no override applied. Its COMPASS-on-PLA source is transcribed as same-family Class-II support (density 1.26 g/cm3, Tg 332 K, within 0.9% and 1 K of this run's pinned experimental targets), not as exact-FF validation of PCFF.

Klajmon2023 (10.1021/acs.iecr.3c03038) stays an autofill validation_data entry only: the critic found its PLA component is not confirmably OPLS-parametrized (the paper's explicit OPLS parametrization applies to PVP), so it is topic-relevant protocol context and counts as FF support neither for nor against PCFF. The autofill entry is left untouched.

Two residual gaps are recorded rather than acted on: parameter_coverage for this exact SMILES remains UNMEASURED (no EMC trial build ran; the check_typing probe was unavailable in this headless session, so the build stage is the first real measurement), and the single-rate 100 K/ns Tg sweep is expected to overpredict Tg relative to the 331 K target on the PLA precedent — grade that as a cooling-rate artifact, not a force-field defect.

No protocol overrides issued deliberately: this run is part of the stereo_r2 revision matrix where seeds are the only intended within-system variable, so changing any decided_param here would break cross-run comparability.

Re-adjudication pass: the prior verdict stands unchanged. The critic's 'agrees' on D-01_ff carries suggested_override=null, so overrides remain empty; no new critic evidence is transcribed because its sole source (10.1007/s00894-020-04431-3, COMPASS-on-PLA) is already on this row at origin='critic', and adjudicate_node appends without deduplicating on source_doi, so re-emitting it would double-count in llm_contribution.py.

Narrowing the recorded parameter_coverage gap without closing it: this run's SMILES *[C@@H](C)C(=O)O* has the same heavy-atom connectivity as the *C(C)C(=O)O* form that built under PCFF/EMC in round 1; the PEST repeat unit known to fail PCFF typing is the *OC(C)C(*)=O ordering, which this is not. Coverage for this exact stereo-specified SMILES is still UNMEASURED (no EMC trial build ran), but the prior is a measured PASS on matching connectivity rather than an untested ordering.

Confidence held at medium rather than raised: parameter_coverage is asserted from ff_accuracy_prior and not measured, and the strongest FF support remains same-family Class-II rather than an exact-PCFF PLA benchmark. Neither the critique nor this pass produced evidence that moves it in either direction.

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PEST.ff_note: PCFF via EMC (build-tested: PLA PASS, PET PASS). PCFF has explicit ester types (c_1, o_2, oe) covering this backbone; GAFF2 was rejected for the same Class-I Tg-accuracy reasons general to polar EMC-routed classes. Klajmon2023 benchmarks PLA/PEG AA-MD (CrossRef-verified DOI, full text ACS-paywall-blocked this session -- treated as topic-relevant, not independently re-confirmed). No PCFF-specific (as opposed to COMPASS/DREIDING/GAFF) density or Tg error for PLA or a small-molecule ester analog has been found despite a dedicated search. This class's +12.8% measured Tg offset is attributed to the known single-rate cooling-rate artifact common to all classes, with no independent literature FF-accuracy check available either way. No field-override recommended.

evidence.claim: Definitive protocol comparison: stepwise vs continuous cooling, temperature ranges, cooling rates for polymer electrolytes. Protocol: 40-540 K sweep, 20 K steps, 2 ns eq + 2 ns prod per step.

evidence.citation: Klajmon, M. et al. Glass Transition and Structure of Organic Polymers from All-Atom Molecular Simulations. Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 2023, 62, 21437–21448.
evidence.claim: All-atom MD benchmark for Tg and density of PLA, PEG, and PVP; quantifies equilibration protocol errors and polydispersity effects. Density identified as the most reliable Tg observable regardless of protocol. Informs PEST (PLA) and POXI (PEG) simulation setup. NOTE: paper covers PLA/PEG/PVP — not PC/PA/PEEK as previously annotated.

nchain_below_production_minimum.detail: nchain=10 is below the advisory PCFF production minimum 20. Its source ("Bejagam 2020") has no copy in this repo and no verified DOI, so the claim is unchecked; nchain>=10 (Wang 2021, verified) IS met, and Hayashi 2022 (RadonPy) ran nchain=10 across 1,077 polymers. Raising nchain to 20 at a fixed system-mass floor would halve per-chain MW (worse chain-length bias); raising it at fixed DP doubles cost for no criterion this module can state. Reported, not applied -- the L>=2*Rg finite-size gate (a separate, already-mechanized check) is the binding constraint on nchain; supply a nchain is now a pure function of the system-mass floor.
